location_exception_reason: Portable huts are industrial/commercial structures sold on material, panel type, size, and insulation grade — not geographic origin. Location in title is redundant; buyer filters by product specs and seller location independently.
biz_exception_reason: Business-type words (Manufacturer, Supplier, Dealer) in titles are redundant; IndiaMART already exposes seller business type as a buyer-facing filter. Removing 'Manufacturer' or 'Supplier' from a portable hut title leaves the product meaning unchanged.
